usedFor: verifi.email checks addresses for validity and deliverability with “Verify Email Address”.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Verify Email Address” in verifi.email
bestTemplate.why: A sender's address is checked on arrival, so you know before replying.

watchOut: A failed check is only a result, so add a step that decides what to do with it.
